items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: was up there, Pete Rugolo and those guys, we'd run them off the field.

ctx.x: We had good arrangements. I had half of Basie's book. I had part of Lunceford's book and a whole lot of things from Jimmy Mundy (PHONETIC) and all the big-time arrangers, had a real hot band. It was very good. We played for all the football things, all the baseball games and things. We used to have a battle of bands with the Coast Guard Band, that

was up there, Pete Rugolo and those guys, we'd run them off the field. We were so hot. We were positively the leading band they had. I got a lot of citations and things from the government for well-dones, which was nice.
